fact: AERC reports that CURDES, the University of Burundi's research centre, held a workshop on 25 August 2023 in Bujumbura presenting three research papers on mobile money and financial inclusion to the central bank, finance ministry and banks.
Authors from the Universite du Burundi published a study in the Open Journal of Social Sciences surveying 343 students on ICT services and e-learning in Burundian higher education.
